hints.en: Tell her your name and say it's nice to meet her.
t: ngo5 giu3 Dan, hou2 gou1 hing3 jing6 sik1 nei5.

hints.en: Say you're American and you live in Chicago.
t: 我係美國人，我住喺芝加哥。
ngo5 hai6 mei5 gwok3 jan4, ngo5 zyu6 hai2 zi1 gaa1 go1.

hints.en: Ask her where her family lives.
t: nei5 uk1 kei2 jan4 zyu6 hai2 bin1 dou6 aa3?

hints.en: Point at the photo and say this is your wife.
t: ni1 go3 hai6 ngo5 lou5 po4.

hints.en: Say this one is your mom and that one is your dad.
t: 呢個係我媽媽，嗰個係我爸爸。
ni1 go3 hai6 ngo5 maa4 maa1, go2 go3 hai6 ngo5 baa4 baa1.

hints.en: Say your mom is in Chicago.
t: ngo5 maa4 maa1 hai2 zi1 gaa1 go1.
ngo5 lou5 po4 hai6 mei5 gwok3 jan4.
